description: Eight lag generators each with a VCA, for smoothing gates so that they do not click or for using a gate as an attack-release envelope, with a mixing scheme that groups any run of channels together

params.text: Sets the rise time shared by all eight lag generators
Sets the fall time shared by all eight lag generators
Sets the level of the mix outputs, on an audio taper

inputs.text: The gate or control voltage that channel smooths; left unpatched, the channel takes the signal from the nearest patched gate jack above it, so one gate at the top drives all eight
The audio that channel's VCA passes, scaled by the lag output; left unpatched it acts as a steady 10V, so the lagged gate itself comes out
Lengthens the rise time of all eight lag generators, added to the Rise knob
Lengthens the fall time of all eight lag generators, added to the Fall knob

outputs.text: That channel's audio input multiplied by its lag generator, or the lagged gate on its own when nothing is patched to that channel's audio input
A mix of that channel and of every channel above it whose own mix jack is unpatched, scaled by the Level knob

notes: the gate inputs and the mix outputs are normalled down the panel, so one gate at the top drives all eight channels and the bottom mix jack carries every channel above it
